# Grammar directives

A directive is a `#set!` line in a grammar's `queries.scm` that changes how a capture behaves.
Write it inside the pattern it applies to:

```scheme
(pattern) @capture (#set! "<name>" "<value>")
```

A `capture.<name>.*` directive must sit on a pattern that binds `@<name>`. Set each name once per
file. A directive not in the table fails at load. See [captures](captures.md).

<!-- generated:directives — do not edit. Regenerate with `bun run schema:generate`. -->

| directive                     | values                         | what it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `selfNesting`                 | -                              | Nested nodes of a capture become elements of their own, for every capture. The file-wide form of `capture.<name>.selfNesting`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `attach.gap`                  | a whole number                 | Rows a comment may end above a definition and still attach to it. 1 means directly above, 2 allows one blank row, 0 attaches nothing. Default 1.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `docstring.owner`             | next \| enclosing \| module    | Which definition a docstring documents: `next` is the one after it, `enclosing` is the one around it, `module` is the file itself (a header comment; a definition directly below still claims it). Default `enclosing`.                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `capture.<name>.definition`   | true \| false                  | Makes the capture an element a rule can target. Default true for function, method, class, type and binding; false for comment, import and docstring. A capture of your own must set this.                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `capture.<name>.leaf`         | true \| false                  | Hides every other capture inside this one, so they produce no elements. Default true for function, method and binding; false for the rest.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `capture.<name>.selfNesting`  | true \| false                  | A node nested in another of the same capture becomes an element of its own. Default false.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `capture.<name>.absorbTail`   | a whole number                 | Bytes a wrapper node may add after the capture, such as a final `;`, and still read as the same element. Default 2 for class, type and binding; otherwise 0.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `capture.<name>.merge`        | contiguous \| adjacent \| none | Joins a run of same-capture nodes into one element. `contiguous` ends the run at a blank row, at other source between two nodes, at another element, or at a node that does not start its row (so a trailing comment stays alone); `adjacent` ends it only at another element; `none` joins nothing. Default `none`; `import` defaults to `contiguous`. The embedded grammars set `comment` to `contiguous`. |
| `capture.<name>.naming`       | strict \| first                | Settles a node that one pattern matches several times with different names, such as `int i, j;`. `strict` fails the load, `first` keeps the name that comes first in the source. Default `strict`.                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `capture.<name>.omit`         | a capture the queries emit     | Leaves the nodes of another capture out of this one's text, such as the `>` of a quoted line. The span does not change. Default: nothing is left out.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `capture.<name>.nameOmit`     | a regular expression           | Leaves what a regular expression matches out of this capture's names, such as the closing `##` of a heading. Default: nothing is left out.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `capture.<name>.valueOmit`    | a regular expression           | Leaves what a regular expression matches out of this capture's values, such as the quotes around a string. A pattern binds the value with `@value`. Default: nothing is left out.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `capture.<name>.injection`    | the id of a grammar            | Parses this capture's text with another grammar, and captures what that grammar's queries find in it. Default: the text is not parsed again.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `capture.<name>.ownsComments` | true \| false                  | Whether the comments inside this capture and directly above it are its documentation. Default true.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
